supplied_reference_deck.request: Explain the supplied deck; do not infer that the user locked this as their build
mechanisms: Pack of Wonders replays friendly enter-play effects
Treasure Trove leaves-board trigger works on bounce and yields draw plus rune
Fizz reuses spells with Energy no more than 3, still paying Power and additional costs, then recycles the spell
Bewitching Spirit can be replayed to force repeated discard
Legend draws from qualifying enemy selections; The List is a gear ability and does not qualify
Champion reduces optional additional costs such as Repeat, not base costs
Vex prevents newly played opposing units from moving that turn while Vex is at a battlefield
Watcher supplies global temporary Might reduction and can Accelerate for conquest windows
supplied_reference_deck.win_condition: Use cumulative cards, runes and tempo to establish and protect battlefield scoring units; Watcher supplies a later breakthrough. No separate direct-point or infinite combo is evidenced.
supplied_reference_deck.limits: Analysis of effective text and structural legality only; not gameplay simulation or proof of competitive strength.
